notes: Read-only analysis of captured DOM and public shipped JavaScript. No device action was invoked.
Apply exact trimmed text matches only inside safeSelectors, with excludeSelectors taking priority. Preserve original leading/trailing whitespace.
Do not translate device names, account identifiers, addresses, map labels, location timestamps, route points, user messages, or input values.
Map/Hybrid labels are app-owned controls outside #map. Do not translate geographic labels or generic Baidu map DOM.
Hidden dialog strings are included as label translations only; never click their controls or invoke APIs.

Authentication .title-msg may combine fixed text and account identifiers. Exact matching can safely translate static messages; preserve combined account strings unchanged unless a narrowly scoped capture-and-preserve rule is explicitly added.
The SIM-lock warning translation follows the shipped text literally; this artifact does not provide SIM or device-security advice.
